name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd
about: Avenue Supermarts Limited (DMart) is a national supermarket chain, with a focus on value-retailing. We offer a wide range of products with a focus on the Foods, Non-Foods (FMCG) and General Merchandise & Apparel product categories.[1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] [2] The company runs the DMart retail chain, which opened its first store in Mumbai in 2002. It follows an "Everyday Low Cost - Everyday Low Price" strategy, built on competitive procurement, efficient operations and low-cost distribution. This allows DMart to offer value-for-money prices to its customers.
cons: Stock is trading at 8.14 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend

announcements.text: Store Opening Intimation 21 Nov - Opened new store at Sivakasi, Virudhunagar (Tamil Nadu); total stores now 521.
Intimation of Repayment of Commercial Paper (CP) 18 Nov - Avenue Supermarts redeemed Rs. 200 crore commercial paper on 18 November 2026; outstanding amount now nil.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 13 Nov - Avenue Supermarts approved senior management changes effective 16 November 2026.
Intimation of Repayment of Commercial Paper (CP) 9 Nov - Avenue Supermarts redeemed INR 300 crore commercial paper on 9 November 2026; outstanding amount is nil.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS 5 Nov - Allotment of equity shares under Avenue Supermarts Limited ESOP Scheme 2023
